# Security

This repository is a fork of [omacom/omarchy-iso](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy-iso) carrying the Omarchy Fleet work. It is not Omarchy, and reports about it do not reach Omarchy's maintainers.

## Report a vulnerability in this fork's own changes

Use this repository's Security tab and choose "Report a vulnerability", which opens a private advisory only the maintainers of this fork can read. Please do not open a public issue for something exploitable.

This fork's own changes are the offline package set handling under `builder/` and its test. Everything else here is upstream's.

## Report a vulnerability in Omarchy itself

Report it to the [Omarchy Security Team](https://omarchy.org/teams/#security) at [security@omarchy.org](mailto:security@omarchy.org?subject=Security%20report), so the fix reaches every Omarchy user rather than only this fork.
